research.title: Occlusion-Aware Temporal Consistency for Monocular Depth Estimation
bullets: Formulated whether visibility uncertainty could reduce erroneous temporal supervision in monocular depth estimation, focusing on disocclusions and independently moving objects.
Led development of visibility-weighted consistency losses and evaluated depth predictions against photometric baselines using controlled occlusion tests and component ablations.

research.title: Confidence-Gated Adaptation for Visual Recognition under Appearance Shift
bullets: Investigated when prediction confidence provides reliable supervision for adapting image classifiers to changing illumination, texture, and background conditions.
Led development of confidence-gated feature alignment, comparing fixed and adaptive acceptance criteria through corruption evaluations and analyses of incorrect pseudo-labels.

research.title: Boundary-Aware Learning for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Formulated how boundary ambiguity affects segmentation learned from image-level labels, and led development of uncertainty-aware seed expansion and region consistency objectives.
Designed comparative experiments separating seed quality, boundary refinement, and augmentation consistency, with ablations examining object extent errors and background leakage.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Features for Image Matching
bullets: Implemented patch extraction, descriptor matching, and geometric verification for image pairs, comparing gradient-based descriptors with normalized intensity patches.
Evaluated correspondence reliability under rotation, blur, and viewpoint changes, inspecting mismatches and comparing nearest-neighbor filtering with ratio-based acceptance.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and partial network fine-tuning using a pretrained convolutional backbone, maintaining consistent preprocessing and training splits.
Compared classification behavior across training schedules and augmentation settings, examining confusion patterns and sensitivity to class imbalance without changing evaluation partitions.

projects.title: Classical and Neural Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising model for images corrupted with synthetic noise under matched evaluation conditions.
Compared reconstruction fidelity and edge preservation across noise settings, examining residual images to distinguish oversmoothing from remaining structured artifacts.
